name: AriaOS Boot Analyzer & Deep System Optimizer
description: Analyze systemd boot timing (kernel, initrd, userspace, slow units), scan reclaimable caches/logs/orphans, and run deep system cleanup.

tools.name: analyze_boot_time
tools.description: Inspect Linux kernel, initramfs, and systemd service boot latencies (`systemd-analyze`).

tools.name: scan_junk_data
tools.description: Scan user caches (~/.cache), Pacman package cache, systemd journal logs, and temporary directories for reclaimable space.

tools.name: deep_clean_system
tools.description: Safely clean temporary caches, old logs, and thumbnail caches to reclaim disk and RAM.

tools.name: optimize_services
tools.description: Inspect or toggle non-essential background services (e.g. bluetooth, cups, ModemManager) to speed up boot time.
